ns2:course.label: Photography, III
ns2:course.description: Explores creative expression through the medium of photography. Students select format and process (i.e., black and white, color, mixed media) based on prior experience; group critiques held frequently; initial opportunity to experiment in personally selected directions which will be refined and amplified in ARTS 460. May be repeated to a maximum of 12 hours. Prerequisite: Junior standing in Photography or consent of instructor.
